verdict.rationale: WorkOS is a SaaS identity platform that ships SDKs, a CLI migrations tool and a dashboard, so opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking or any opt-out control. The cited items cover SSO, Directory Sync, RBAC, audit logs, Vault, MCP and SDK retry behavior, none of which address this story.
